{
 "path": "programs/task-72225765.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # The 3x3 zero patch is an occlusion: output the corresponding cells
    # reflected across the horizontal center axis of the 24x24 pattern.
    n = len(grid)
    zeros = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 0]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, _ in zeros), max(r for r, _ in zeros)
    c0, c1 = min(c for _, c in zeros), max(c for _, c in zeros)
    return [[grid[n - 1 - r][c] for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)]
            for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
"
}
